title: Clouds
description: Connect cloud storage accounts so your agents can browse and organize your files.
regrant_hint: This account was connected with read-only scopes. Re-grant access so the agent can upload, rename, move and delete files.

empty.title: No cloud accounts connected
empty.description: Pick a storage provider above, finish the one-time setup, then connect an account to let your agent browse your Drive.

picker.title: Choose a storage provider
picker.description: Pick a provider first — accounts are connected per provider, so nothing gets mixed up.
picker.google_desc: Google Drive via your own GCP OAuth client. Gmail tools included.
picker.onedrive_desc: Microsoft OneDrive (personal or work/school) via your own Azure app.
picker.more_via_rclone: More storages (Dropbox, S3, WebDAV, …) planned on the same rclone engine

setup.body: GoClaw uses your own OAuth client (bring your own client). One-time setup:
setup.google_step1: Create an OAuth client (type "Web application") in the Google Cloud console and add the Drive scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive (full access — required for upload/rename/delete).
setup.google_step2: Publish the app to production (unverified is fine) so refresh tokens do not expire after 7 days.
setup.google_step3: Enter the Client ID and Client Secret below and press Save — the credentials are stored encrypted and this form will not appear again.
setup.google_step4: Register this exact redirect URI in the Google Cloud console:
setup.onedrive_step1: In the Azure portal, register a new app (Microsoft Entra ID > App registrations). Supported account types: accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts. Add the Files.ReadWrite.All API permission (work/school tenants may need admin consent).
setup.onedrive_step2: Under Authentication, add the Web platform and register the redirect URI below.
setup.onedrive_step3: Create a client secret (Certificates & secrets) and copy its Value.
setup.onedrive_step4: Register this exact redirect URI in the Azure app:
setup.client_secret_keep: Client Secret (leave empty to keep the saved one)
setup.embedded_note: Quick connect uses the shared rclone OAuth client — no setup needed, with shared rate limits. The embedded client now grants full Drive access. Gmail tools still require your own OAuth client (see Cloud settings).

disconnect_confirm.title: Disconnect account?
disconnect_confirm.description: "{{email}}" will be removed from GoClaw. Your files are untouched; you can connect again anytime.

paste.title: Finish connecting
paste.description: After you approve access, the browser lands on a page that will not load — that is expected. Copy the full URL from the address bar and paste it here.
paste.placeholder: Paste the address-bar URL (starts with http://127.0.0.1:53682/…)

share.title: Share link
share.public_warning: Anyone with this link can view the file until the provider revokes it.

settings.title: Cloud settings
settings.description: Manage providers, your own OAuth client and scope rules.

scope.title: Usage scopes
scope.description: Pick which account the agent uses here: explicit request wins, then group, then user, then the organization default, then personal accounts.
scope.missing_fields: Pick a scope key and an account first
scope.key_hint_group: Pick a group the agent has talked in, or paste its chat id.
scope.key_hint_user: Pick a user id from recent conversations, or paste one.

detail.files_unavailable: Could not list files (is rclone installed on the server?)
detail.readonly_note: Read-only view via rclone ({{provider}}). Ask the agent to fetch or organize files.
detail.mail_readonly_note: Preview only — ask the agent to search, read or clean up mail.

drive.not_found: Account not found or no longer accessible

files.delete_confirm_description: {{count}} item(s) will be permanently deleted. Folders must be empty to be deleted. This cannot be undone.
files.readonly_banner: Read-only account — re-grant access to upload, rename, move or delete files.
files.write_disabled_hint: This account is read-only — use “Re-grant access” to restore write permission.
files.scope_required: This account is missing write access — re-grant access and try again.

transfer.title: Transfer to another account
transfer.move_folder_hint: Folders are always copied, even in Move mode — the source folder is never deleted.
transfer.background_running: Large folders keep transferring in the background.

sync.section_description: One-way mirror of a folder from one account into another. Files are only copied — nothing is ever deleted at the target.
sync.run_queued: Sync queued — check the status in a moment
sync.delete_confirm: Files already copied stay at the target. The schedule stops.
sync.same_pair_error: Source and target must differ (account + folder).

starred.title: Starred
starred.empty: No starred files or folders yet.
starred.name: Name
starred.account_gone: This account is no longer accessible

recent.title: Recent
recent.empty: Nothing opened yet on this device.
recent.description: Stored on this device only — never sent to the server.
recent.clear_confirm: The list on this device will be emptied.

preview.cannot_preview: This file type cannot be previewed.
preview.too_large: File is larger than {{cap}} — download it to view.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts are ignored while typing in a field.
